user.title: Sign in to Sunrun
user.description: Enter the mobile number on your Sunrun account. Sunrun will text you a 6-digit code.

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Enter the code Sunrun texted you. Tick the box and submit to send a new code instead.

name.title: Name this system
name.description: Used for the device and the statistic name.

error.login_refused: Sunrun did not accept this number. Check it and try again later.
error.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Tick "Send a new code" to get another.

abort.no_sites: No solar sites were found on this account.
abort.wrong_account: This sign-in belongs to a different Sunrun site.
